svg.title: Runtime execution and tool access
svg.desc: The local server starts runtimes separately from providing tools. Claude Code calls DorkOS tools in process; agent-bound Codex, OpenCode and Doe turns use a loopback MCP listener with turn-bound credentials; the computer-local experiment reaches the same listener through a fixed-target bridge into its guest. Doe also assembles local engine tools. Room speech requires a tool action. External MCP has separate authentication. Every tool call writes one audit row.
